import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] network = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] maze = new char[20][20];
    static int size_x, size_y, total_vertices, target_distance[][] = new int[10][10];
    static int[] parent_node = new int[7000], flow_amount = new int[7000];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int INF = 1000000;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < network.length; i++) {
            network[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int flow_augment(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < 1; iter++) {
            Arrays.fill(parent_node, -1);
            parent_node[s] = s;
            flow_amount[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) {
                    int v = u;
                    int flow = flow_amount[t];
                    while (v != s) {
                        int p = parent_node[v];
                        network[p].put(v, network[p].getOrDefault(v, 0) - flow);
                        network[v].put(p, network[v].getOrDefault(p, 0) + flow);
                        v = p;
                    }
                    total_flow += flow;
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> it : network[u].entrySet()) {
                    int v = it.getKey();
                    int capacity = it.getValue();
                    if (capacity >= cap && parent_node[v] == -1) {
                        parent_node[v] = u;
                        flow_amount[v] = Math.min(capacity, flow_amount[u]);
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    static int encode_node(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * size_x + t * size_x * size_x + 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size_x = sc.nextInt();
        size_y = sc.nextInt();

        int total_res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size_x; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < size_x; j++) {
                maze[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (maze[i][j] > '0' && maze[i][j] <= '9') {
                    network[0].put(encode_node(i, j, 0), maze[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size_x; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            maze[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                target_distance[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> q_bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = size_x - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = size_x - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (maze[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    target_distance[i][j] = 0;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q_bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q_bfs.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int t = target_distance[i][j];
                int x = i + dx[dir], y = j + dy[dir];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < size_x && y < size_x && maze[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < target_distance[x][y]) {
                    target_distance[x][y] = t + 1;
                    q_bfs.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        total_vertices = encode_node(size_x - 1, size_x - 1, 0) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < size_x; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size_x; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
                    if (t < 10) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q], y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < size_x && y < size_x && maze[x][y] != 'Y') {
                                int t_next = t + 1;
                                if (t_next < target_distance[x][y] + (maze[x][y] > '0' && maze[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0) && t < target_distance[i][j]) {
                                    network.computeIfAbsent(encode_node(i, j, t), k -> new HashMap<>())
                                            .put(encode_node(x, y, t_next), 1000);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (maze[i][j] > '0' && maze[i][j] <= '9') {
                            network.computeIfAbsent(encode_node(i, j, t), k -> new HashMap<>())
                                    .put(encode_node(i, j, 10), maze[i][j] - '0');
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (maze[i][j] > '0' && maze[i][j] <= '9') {
                    network.computeIfAbsent(encode_node(i, j, 10), k -> new HashMap<>())
                            .put(1, maze[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            total_res += flow_augment(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(total_res);
        sc.close();
    }
}
